input.cmd: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $s10Os=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; $s10Disk=Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter "DeviceID = 'C:'"; $s10Heavy=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(vivado|vitis|xsim|xvlog|xelab|v\+\+|vitis_hls|cc1plus|g\+\+|make)\.exe$' }; [ordered]@{at_utc8=[DateTimeOffset]::Now.ToOffset([TimeSpan]::FromHours(8)).ToString('o');available_ram_bytes=[long]$s10Os.FreePhysicalMemory*1024;total_ram_bytes=[long]$s10Os.TotalVisibleMemorySize*1024;c_disk_free_bytes=[long]$s10Disk.FreeSpace;heavy=@($s10Heavy | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,WorkingSetSize)} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress
input.justification: 只读核验当前内存和相关重型工具PID，避免与S10开发回归或其他窗口重型任务重叠。
